metadata.title: [TESTING][SECURITY]: Add OWASP A01 direct and ZAP DAST test suites
metadata.author: gcgoncalves

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Relates to #259

---

## 📝 Summary
Introduces two-layer DAST coverage for OWASP A01:2025 – Broken Access Control.

Layer 1 – direct Playwright API tests (no ZAP required, marker: owasp_a01):
- Force browsing: 7 endpoints must reject anonymous requests with 401
- IDOR/cross-tenant: Team A token must not access Team B resources (CWE-639)
- Vertical privilege escalation: non-admin cannot reach admin-only APIs (CWE-269/285)
- JWT tampering: unsigned, payload-modified, expired, alg=none, wrong iss/aud (CWE-345/287)
- CORS: no wildcard or reflected ACAO header for arbitrary origins (CWE-942)

Layer 2 – ZAP DAST integration (marker: owasp_a01_zap, skipped when ZAP_BASE_URL unset):
- Spider discovers protected endpoints; passive scan checks for HIGH/CRITICAL A01 CWEs; active scan checks for CRITICAL findings; JSON report written to tests/reports/

Infrastructure:
- docker-compose.yml: add zap service under --profile testing (ports 8090/8091, waits for nginx health, 60 s JVM start_period, 2 CPU / 2 GB limit)
- pyproject.toml: add python-owasp-zap-v2.4>=0.0.21 to playwright extras; register owasp_a01 and owasp_a01_zap pytest markers

Run without ZAP:  make test-owasp
Run with ZAP:     make testing-up test-zap

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body:
This one might cause false positives as it is, at least this way we get a skip instead of a false positive if it times out.
```suggestion
            pytest.skip("Active scan exceeded 15 min timeout - results incomplete. Increase timeout or optimize scan scope.")
```

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body:
If you can use specific Exceptions here instead of the generic exception it creates far more robust code.

```suggestion
            except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ImportError) as exc:
                pytest.skip(
                    "ZAP connection lost during active scan; proceeding with partial results. Error: %s",
                    exc,
                )
                break
            
```
(you'll need to import those exception types as well.

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body: As below, you should use more specific exceptions if possible before defaulting to the generic Exception.

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body:
This one can lead to false positive/missing coverage, if you change it to:

```suggestion
        pytest.skip(
        f"ZAP Replacer add-on required for authenticated endpoint testing. "
        f"Install it in ZAP or tests will only cover public endpoints. Error: {exc}"
    )
```
At least it will notify of the skip and give a message that is useful to resolve.

reviews.author: vishu-bh
reviews.body:
- Summary of change

  - Adds OWASP A01 (Broken Access Control) security tests under tests/playwright/security/owasp/ with two layers:
  - Direct Playwright API tests for force-browsing, IDOR (cross-tenant/user), privilege escalation, JWT tampering/expiry, and CORS behavior.
  - Optional OWASP ZAP DAST scan with spidering, passive/active checks, and JSON report artifacts.
  - Adds Make targets test-owasp and test-zap.
  - Adds a ZAP service to docker-compose.yml for the testing profile.
  - Updates testing docs navigation to include “Security Testing”.
 
 - **What’s good**
   - Strong, focused A01 coverage with realistic attack patterns.
   - ZAP integration is gated by environment variables and produces reports for CI artifacts.
   - Fixtures create/cleanup test users, teams, and servers to keep isolation.
- **Concerns / improvements**
   - pyproject.toml was not updated with the python-owasp-zap-v2.4 dependency or new pytest markers (owasp_a01, owasp_a01_zap) as stated in the PR summary.
   - docs/docs/testing/security.md is referenced in nav but doesn’t exist.
   - Default pytest addopts ignore tests/playwright, so make test-owasp / make test-zap likely won’t run unless addopts are overridden.
   - ZAP_TARGET_URL default uses host.docker.internal, which isn’t available on many Linux setups; consider documenting http://nginx:8080 as a Linux-safe default.
 
- Security notes
  - ZAP is bound to 0.0.0.0 with api.addrs.addr.name=.* Consider restricting to 127.0.0.1 or requiring a non-default key to avoid accidental exposure.
   - Only one test asserts expiration; most JWT tokens don’t set exp. Recommend adding explicit exp to all test tokens for realism while keeping the dedicated expired-token test.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review Summary

Rebased onto main, reviewed, tested, and enhanced. **31/31 tests pass** from a clean `make testing-up && make testing-zap-up` run.

### Original PR (commit 1)
Solid two-layer OWASP A01:2021 test suite:
- **Layer 1**: 24 direct Playwright tests — force browsing, cross-tenant IDOR, vertical privilege escalation, JWT tampering (6 attack types), CORS enforcement
- **Layer 2**: 4 ZAP DAST tests — OpenAPI spec import, spider, passive scan, active scan, JSON/HTML reports
- Supporting: docker-compose ZAP service, Makefile targets, conftest fixtures, pytest markers, docs

### Review fixes (commits 2–6)

| Fix | Details |
|-----|---------|
| **OWASP version** | `A01:2025` → `A01:2021` (no 2025 edition exists) |
| **Cleanup path bug** | `non_admin_ctx` fixture deleted users at wrong endpoint (`/admin/users/` → `/auth/email/admin/users/`) — would silently leak test users |
| **Code dedup** | Removed duplicate `_make_jwt`/`_api_context` from test file; imports from conftest |
| **Dead code** | Removed unused `_UNSET` sentinel |
| **Type annotation** | Added `teams: list[str] \| None` to conftest `_make_jwt` |
| **ZAP profile separation** | Moved ZAP from `testing` to dedicated `dast` profile — `make testing-zap-up/down` |
| **Dead port** | Removed unused 8091 port mapping; ZAP daemon only serves on 8090 |
| **Cross-user IDOR tests** | Added `TestIDORCrossUserObjects` (3 tests) — User B can't read/update/delete User A's private server. Fixed fixture to use admin API for server creation |
| **HTML reports** | Added `_write_html_report()` via `zap.core.htmlreport()` alongside JSON |
| **OpenAPI import** | ZAP now imports the full OpenAPI spec (367 URLs) instead of manually seeding 5 paths |
| **Scoped active scan** | Active scan targets 7 security-sensitive prefixes (`/auth/`, `/rbac/`, `/tokens/`, `/servers`, `/teams/`, `/tools`, `/gateways`) with 45min timeout instead of full surface with 15min |
| **ZAP memory** | 16GB limit / 8GB reservation — active scan peaked at 6GB |
| **ZAP resilience** | All ZAP API calls (passive scan polling, alert retrieval, report generation) now handle connection errors gracefully |

### ZAP DAST Results (clean run)
- **367 URLs** discovered via OpenAPI import
- **0 A01 access control alerts** (HIGH/CRITICAL)
- **HTML report** + JSON reports in `tests/reports/` (gitignored)

commits.message:
fix: review fixes for OWASP A01 test suite

- Fix OWASP version references: A01:2025 → A01:2021 (2021 is latest release)
- Remove duplicate _make_jwt and _api_context from test file; import from conftest
- Remove unused _UNSET sentinel variable
- Fix cleanup path bug: /admin/users/{email} → /auth/email/admin/users/{email}
- Add type annotation for teams parameter in conftest _make_jwt
- Apply black/isort formatting

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: separate ZAP into dedicated dast profile and harden resilience

- Move ZAP from "testing" to "dast" Docker Compose profile so it doesn't
  start with make testing-up (avoids ~600MB pull and 1GB+ RAM for devs
  who don't need DAST)
- Add make testing-zap-up / testing-zap-down targets
- Add connection-error resilience to passive scan and report tests
  (ZAP can OOM and restart mid-run; previously only active scan handled this)
- Update docs to reflect new workflow

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

Port 8091 was mapped but never used.

  (non-admin users with teams=[] lack servers.create permission)

commits.message:
fix: bump ZAP to 4GB and import OpenAPI spec for full API coverage

- Increase ZAP memory limit from 2GB to 4GB (reservation 2GB)
- Import FastAPI's /openapi.json spec via zap.openapi.import_url()
  for full 300+ endpoint coverage instead of manually seeding 5 paths
- Fall back to manual seeding if OpenAPI import fails
- Update docs to reflect 4GB requirement

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
